54200.summary: The class explores Zechariah's prophecy, contrasting Alexander the Great with Jesus Christ to illustrate true leadership and the shepherd king. It emphasizes the importance of spiritual leadership and the contrast between human conquest and divine salvation.

54201.summary: The class contrasts Jesus Christ with Alexander the Great, emphasizing Christ's humility, justice, and ability to save others. It explores Zechariah 9:9-17, highlighting Christ's role as a righteous king and the call to turn to him as a stronghold.

54202.summary: The class explores Zechariah 9:10 and Mark 10:46-11:19, focusing on how Jesus brings peace and salvation to both Jews and Gentiles. It emphasizes the Gentiles' inclusion into the hope of Israel through the New Covenant, highlighting the gospel's Israelite origins and the grafting of Gentiles into the olive tree of Israel's promises.

54203.summary: The class covers Zechariah chapters 10 and 11, focusing on the themes of divine strengthening, the return of the Jewish people to Israel, and the role of the Messiah as a suffering servant. It emphasizes the importance of faith, prayer, and righteous living in preparation for the kingdom of God.

54204.summary: The class explores Zechariah 11, focusing on the Good Shepherd and the rejection of Jesus, emphasizing the value of Christ and the importance of faith and discipleship.

54205.summary: The class explores Zechariah 14, focusing on the vision of Yahweh's feet standing on the Mount of Olives and the earthquake that will reshape Jerusalem, enabling Jews to flee. It emphasizes the removal of opposition and the establishment of Yahweh's kingdom, where all nations will worship the king and keep the feast of tabernacles.
